hero.label: Made for Sim
hero.headline: I am eager to drive growth as Sim's Founding Sales member.
hero.subheadline: Sim's commitment to innovative solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for technology-driven growth. I am excited to build and shape the sales foundation in an environment that values creativity and impact.

whyCompany.title: Innovative solutions offered by Sim
whyCompany.body: Sim stands out for its unique approach to market challenges. Their innovative drive to create impactful solutions excites me about contributing to a forward-thinking team.

whyCompany.title: Thriving in an early-stage startup
whyCompany.body: Joining Sim at its inception is thrilling as it allows unparalleled influence on growth strategies. Being part of this foundation-building phase offers a chance to leave a lasting mark.

whyCompany.title: Alignment with my sales experience
whyCompany.body: My role in acquiring clients with Copygen.ai and digital marketing at NextAfter equips me with a tactical understanding of B2B sales. I am prepared to leverage these skills to bring success to Sim.

quote: I am drawn to this role because it allows me to innovate and leave my imprint on Sim's pioneering journey.
